name: Kame Aggregator AggregationRouter arbitrary executor call
summary: AggregationRouter.swap forwards caller-chosen executeParams to a caller-chosen executor without validating either. Attackers set the executor to an ERC-20 and the calldata to transferFrom(victim, attacker, amount), so the router spent the unlimited approvals users had given it. The primary attacker, copycats and a white hat drained approvers of both Kame routers on Sei from 2025-09-12 onward.

loss.notes: Exact victim debits from receipt Transfer logs (plus Etherscan-indexed CW20-pointer transfers) of 4008 legs in 2601 successful drain transactions through both Kame routers, 2025-09-12 to block 234150523. Each debit is valued at its hourly DefiLlama price; only stablecoins, wrapped SEI/BTC/ETH/FRAX and liquid staking tokens are valued. Memecoins (about 116.8k USD at DefiLlama prices, excluded because the attackers' disposal likely moved thin markets) and 26 unpriced tokens are left out, so this is a conservative gross figure. Drains through the prior router 0x1415e8ee... (same defect, same campaign, 3978 USD) are merged. White-hat drains and the attacker's later return of 185 ETH are not deducted. Approvals were never revoked onchain by the protocol, and the campaign was still running at the data cutoff (block 234700000).

ageReset.description: The immutable AggregationRouter runtime, CREATE2-deployed with no proxy or configurable state, contains the unvalidated executor call. Users' approvals only set how much could be drained.

sources.note: Reviewed anchor, root cause and first exercise. Verified AggregationRouter source (source-4) swap(SwapParams): after srcToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, executor, amount) it performs params.executor.call{value: msg.value}(params.executeParams) with no validation of executor or calldata, abi-decodes the return as uint256 and emits Swapped. Setting executor to an ERC-20 and executeParams to transferFrom(victim, attacker, amount) makes the router, the spender users approved, move any approver's balance; transferFrom's bool true decodes as returnAmount=1. Source-1: eth_getTransactionReceipt, block 167716634, transactionIndex 0, status 1, timestamp 1757712483 (2025-09-12T21:28:03Z); EOA 0x81317099e791b92130a029001bf27df52ab08292 calls Multicall3 0xca11bde05977b3631167028862be2a173976ca11 aggregate3 (0x82ad56cb). Logs 0/3: JELLY 0x8d4bd7f15ab970bf9ade5b15116cd663bf8c861e Transfer(Multicall3 -> JELLY, 0) = the zero-amount srcToken pull to executor=JELLY; logs 1/4: JELLY Transfer 0x292834329f29ed657e82d9e95d2a21c8865bdd31 -> 0x3a42b17f0d25de388bf0b08ffd860cdbdddfb110 of 12157271582874 and 0x483f701981c592f33b4df707825f9d2df4ac7bdd -> 0x3a42... of 200008582517 (6 decimals); logs 2/5: router Swapped(src=dst=JELLY, amount 0, returnAmount 1). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) (Alchemy Sei archive) shows Multicall3 -> router swap twice, each making JELLY.transferFrom(Multicall3, JELLY, 0) then JELLY.transferFrom(victim, 0x3a42..., amount) from the router. Earliest-use scan: Etherscan V2 logs.getLogs chainid=1329 on the router, topic0 Swapped 0x384d8f89ff96881986274bc0c1a0bbe8d85b10cf8b0c161dfe37fef72d277e28, blocks 155226564..168400000 paged by block (209852 logs; superset of all 202946 successful direct router txs from account.txlist, 231863 txs total). Only two Swapped logs before source-1 have returnAmount<=1: 0x3e21d842ab534fe8c5dfcf4048956a480a2d1e2ccebca0a10a6bf7003089cd23 (block 159704763) is a self-funded 1-wei swap through Kame executor 0xc9c26e80051392a2bffa4bd7af01bb2525a605e3, not a drain. Direct swap calls (selector 0xc4b87069, executor = calldata word 4) before source-1 use only Kame executors 0xaf4975aeee5b03ad8b62d9a6a358b9aceb7b9857, 0x2ea4dbbf2444a053d256d677881c4fce9c4baeb2, 0xe162d3b6956b7b49abec7aef12a86b0d412bfd58, 0xc9c26e80... (all CREATE2-deployed by Kame deployer 0x7d20935cd55dc77a3b2a875079cb02a0b4dd04a7) except successful 0xadf29223ccc4a55b7875c218755fad2eb08e0cd17d330df6d2691ea78e591b50 (executor 0xe8bf3873..., caller swaps own WSEI) and 0xcbe85b9d8e84d14e486bd59388c39ecfc2b72cb6b26ad69c4143bb784d466eb1 (executor 0x4eab0dc0..., caller spends own 1 wei LESS): neither debits a third party. The prior version router 0x1415e8eec45dae07e7bbdf57a88ea0a309233617 (source-4) has the same unvalidated executor call; its Swapped scan from deployment block 153007439 to 234000000 (75746 logs) shows the first returnAmount<=1 drain at 0xe05cce002fb34ac67a4958080864d738a6eae283795888e0c2b7c66e6153fe9f, block 167771791, after source-1. The published sample source-8 (block 167720275) and DeFiHackLabs source-7 tx 0x6150ec6b2b1b46d1bcba0cab9c3a77b5bca218fd1cdaad1ddc7a916e4ce792ec (block 167791783, copycat 0xd43d0660601e613f9097d5c75cd04ee0c19e6f65, 17999.88 USDC) are later legs. Not a key compromise or privileged action: every drain is a permissionless swap() call; router owner is the CREATE2 factory and only gates rescueFunds.

Verified AggregationRouter sources: Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=1329 for 0x14bb98581ac1f1a43fd148db7d7d793308dc4d80 (ContractName AggregationRouter, v0.8.26+commit.8a97fa7a, optimizer on; SHA-256 of returned SourceCode 6cf584b7fed17935b2197ac45ec1258f1509944189a8b8ac8eb74a65f83a5738), file src/AggregationRouter.sol, function swap. Same call for 0x1415e8eec45dae07e7bbdf57a88ea0a309233617 returns the prior version, whose swap only adds a nonzero minReturnAmount check (attackers pass 1).

Reviewed gross victim depletion through data cutoff block 234700000 (chain head 234619869 at review start); the router is immutable and approvals were never invalidated, so drains continue: last drain source-9, block 234150523, timestamp 1790391476. Recipe: collect Swapped logs of both routers (source-3 scans, plus 0x14bb... blocks 168400000..234700000: 8370 logs); select returnAmount<=1 (data word 3) and fetch eth_getTransactionReceipt for the 2614 transactions. For each such Swapped at log index i, walk back to the srcToken Transfer (from caller to executor, value == Swapped.amount) or the previous router Swapped; accept the leg only if every log in between is emitted by one token equal to that executor (the direct token.transferFrom call); sum those Transfer logs whose from differs from tx.from, the caller and the recipient. Two Sei CW20-pointer tokens (SEIYAN 0x5f0e07dfee5832faa00c63f2d33a0d79150e8598, MILLI 0x95597eb8d227a7c4b4f5e807a815c5178ee6dbe1) emit no EVM logs; their debits come from Etherscan V2 account.tokentx for those contracts restricted to the same transactions, excluding tx.from/tx.to/caller/recipients. Cross-check: debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of 60 randomly sampled drain transactions (Python random.seed(7) over the sorted successful hashes), collecting router-originated CALLs with selector 0x23b872dd and nonzero amount, reproduces exactly the recipe's legs (including pointer-token legs) with no mismatch. Result: 4008 victim debits in 2601 transactions from 999 distinct victims to 21 recipients (3691 legs via 0x14bb..., 142 via 0x1415..., 175 pointer legs), first debit in source-1. 1226076 USD of the valued total fell by 2025-09-14T00:00Z, 181534 USD later. 1176890 USD went to primary attacker 0x3a42b17f0d25de388bf0b08ffd860cdbdddfb110 (driven by EOA 0x81317099...); 130042 USD to later actor 0xa40f2915f1e7fdc0037c8fe79f4953e260c97814; 21900 USD to 0x5e14b180f3055b7e18a8c4f3edcff3a26126fc24, matching the white-hat recovery in source-6. Largest leg: source-8 log debiting 0x17860b2320a9b43a9b7f4d16fe8e51f4ccfd92b8 (the post-mortem's example victim) 1104318.52 WSEI. Router 0x1415... legs contribute 3978 USD of the valued total. Valuation: each debit is priced at DefiLlama coins.llama.fi/prices/historical/<hour midpoint>/sei:<token>?searchWidth=4h for its block-time hour (719 hourly buckets, retrieved at the price-data observedAt); component unitPriceUsd is the debit-weighted mean and valuation.timestamp the component's last debit. Source-10.. give each component's largest-debit bucket. Only stablecoins, wrapped SEI/BTC/ETH/FRAX and liquid staking tokens are valued. Excluded from loss.usd (so the figure is a conservative gross lower bound): memecoins whose disposal by the attackers likely moved thin markets (MILLI 3103938994.96, DRG 686470.88, YAKA 7871932.79, CHIPS 53796446.93, Frog 44485693.14, SEIYAN 1651284.88, JLY 1427154.80, GGC, RAIIN, APO, KURA; 116828 USD at DefiLlama hourly prices) and 26 tokens without any DefiLlama price (e.g. POPO, SBC, BULLX, Pepei, SHENRN, WILSON, LESS, $gonad, GIGAS, JELLY, POCHITA, UMI, SEIYUN). Source-6 reports 1324535.32 USD across 830 users for its earlier snapshot; the difference is later-campaign drains and pricing basis. Recoveries (185 ETH from the primary attacker, white-hat returns) do not reduce gross loss.

Reviewed artifact identity and age history. Direct immutable runtime, no proxy or delegatecall (source-4). Source-2: Kame deployer EOA 0x7d20935cd55dc77a3b2a875079cb02a0b4dd04a7 calls the CREATE2 factory 0x4e59b44847b379578588920ca78fbf26c0b4956c, block 155226564, transactionIndex 9, timestamp 1751443829; salt 0x7c449fcab93a6a47a6f19779105a6d5967956cc846b56cd3c5d99cc0f7963738 with the remaining calldata as init code derives 0x14bb98581ac1f1a43fd148db7d7d793308dc4d80 (cast create2); receipt log 14 is OwnershipTransferred(0, 0x4e59...) from the new contract; Etherscan V2 getcontractcreation agrees. eth_getCode empty at block 155226563; keccak256(eth_getCode) = 0x39f393386fe428a7ffbe810ec515a563300bd085d0e32fe53d0653840990900a at blocks 155226564 and 167716633 and at head. Storage slot 0 (owner) at block 167716633 is still 0x4e59...; the contract has no other state, no setter, and its only owner function is rescueFunds, so no configuration reset exists. Deployment is the age basis: exploit 1757712483 - 1751443829 = 6268654 s. The prior router 0x1415e8eec45dae07e7bbdf57a88ea0a309233617 (runtime keccak 0x228d517509b38eff4ddb0a82fa8365ef182b71119b43a0d1a70d8cedb93d514d, CREATE2 by the same deployer at block 153007439 in 0x6945e2751010fbaf0d8cbda2b558ec8fddc692841f531fccbe8ef7b4fb207c8a) carries the same defect but was first exercised later (block 167771791), is not executed by the anchor, and is not a target; its drains are merged into the loss.
